name: Smart Resto — Marketing · Dish Promo Video Pipeline

_doc.description: Full pipeline: receives dish data → renders video with Creatomate → publishes to Instagram/TikTok → notifies our server
_doc.trigger: POST /api/marketing/generate-video fires this webhook with campaign data
env_vars_needed: MARKETING_CALLBACK_SECRET — random hex, same as in .env

nodes.name: Webhook — Receive Campaign
nodes._notes:
Path must match N8N_MARKETING_WEBHOOK_URL in .env.
Payload: { campaignId, cafeName, country, productName, productPrice, imageUrl, hasWatermark, platforms, callbackUrl, logoUrl? }

nodes.name: HTTP — POST Creatomate Render

parameters.name: modifications
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ imageUrl: $json.imageUrl, logoUrl: $json.logoUrl, cafeName: $json.cafeName, dishName: $json.productName, price: $json.priceStr, caption: $json.caption, watermarkOpacity: $json.watermarkOpacity }) }}

nodes._notes: Returns an array. First element: { id, status: 'planned'|'rendering'|'succeeded'|'failed', url }

nodes.name: IF — Render succeeded?
nodes._notes: TRUE → publish video. FALSE → check if failed or retry.

nodes.name: IF — Failed or retry?
nodes._notes: TRUE → callback failed. FALSE → loop back to Wait node.

nodes.name: HTTP — Publish via Upload-Post

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'published', videoUrl: $('Code — Check Render Done').first().json.videoUrl, caption: $('Code — Build Creatomate Payload').first().json.caption, uploadPostJobId: $json.jobId ?? null, socialLinks: $json.postUrls ?? null, n8nExecutionId: $execution.id }) }}
